For the purposes of this Ordinance, certain words in the singular number shall include the plural number and words in the plural number shall include the singular number unless the obvious construction of the wording indicates otherwise.

The word "shall" is mandatory.

APPLIANCE. Any mechanical device, including but not limited to, refrigerators, freezers, stoves, ovens, dishwashers, kilns and trash compactors, which device has a door which closes and locks or which closes and forms an airtight seal and which cannot be opened from the inside.

VEHICLE. Any automobile, truck or tractor, which vehicle has doors, hoods or trunk lids which close and lock or which close and form an airtight seal and cannot be opened from the inside.

TRUNKS. Any storage box or other container with a cover or lid which closes and locks or which closes and

forms an airtight seal and cannot be opened from the inside. |

STORED OR STORAGE. Any item which is in the bossessSion, custody or control of the owner and is not in ordinary, frequent and customary use.

ABANDONED. Any item which is not in the

Possession, custody or control of the owner and is not in ordinary, frequent and customary use.
8:
- a. The owner of any appliance, vehicle or trunk stored in an unlocked area accessible to other persons or out-of-doors shall remove or cause to be removed any door, hood or trunk lid or, in the alternative, the owner shall padlock or cause to be Padlocked any door, hood or trunk lid so that it cannot be opened. Before abandoning any appliance, vehicle or trunk, the owner shall remove any door, hood or trunk lid.

- b. The owner of any Property on which any appliance, vehicle or trunk is stored or abandoned in an unlocked area accessible to other persons or out of doors, regardless of whether the owner of the property is the owner of said appliance, vehicle or trunk, shall remove or cause to be removed any door, hood or trunk lid, or in the alternative, shall padiock or cause to be padlocked any door, hood or trunk lid so that it cannot be opened. The owner of any property on which any appliance, vehicle or trunk is stored by person or persons unknown without the permission of the owner of the property may request in writing that said appliance, vehicle or trunk be removed by the Town of Clermont in lieu of complying with this section.

- c. The owner of any business holding any appliance, vehicle Or trunk for sale or resale, whether for his own account or on consignment, and which appliance, vehicle or trunk is stored in an unlocked area accessible by others or out of doors, shall remove or cause to be removed any door, hood or trunk lid, or in the alternative, shall padlock or caused to be padlocked any door, hood or trunk lid so that it cannot be opened.
9:
- a. For any violation of this ordinance, a warrant shall be issued against the offender and he shall appear before the Mayor of the Town of Clermont for a hearing on the issue. The Mayor shall have the authority to impose a fine in the amount of Fifty Dollars ($50.00) for each violation and a sentence of up to Fifty (50) days in jail or community service, or both in his discretion, in accordance with Section 12 of the Charter of the Town of Clermont. Each day of a continuing violation shall be a separate offense punishable hereunder.

- b. For any violation of this ordinance by the owner of a business, in addition to any penalties imposed above, the owner's business license may be revoked by the Mayor, subject to an appeal to the Council. Any appeal must be filed in writing with the Council within ten (10) days of the revocation of the license.

- c. The Mayor and Council shall have the power to enjoin any person from further violation of this ordinance. In addition, in accordance with the powers granted in Section 11 of the Charter of the Town of Clermont, the Mayor and Council shall have the power to remove or abate any dangerous condition caused by any appliance, vehicle or trunk stored or abandoned on any persons' property. All costs and expenses of removal and abatement shall be paid by the offender, including court costs, reasonable attorneys fees and hauling or removal fees.
